note: Shared return-cause taxonomy. Keywords are matched case-insensitively on whole words/phrases against return_reason + customer_comment. Causes are listed in tie-break priority order (most specific first).

causes.label: Compatibility
causes.description: The product does not work with the customer's device, model, or existing equipment.

causes.label: Dimension mismatch
causes.description: Physical size or dimensions differ from what the customer understood from the listing.

causes.label: Fit - too small
causes.description: Clothing or footwear is smaller or tighter than the customer expected for their usual size.

causes.label: Fit - too large
causes.description: Clothing or footwear is larger, longer, or looser than the customer expected for their usual size.

causes.label: Setup difficulty
causes.description: The customer could not set up, assemble, install, or connect the product.

causes.label: Damaged
causes.description: The product arrived broken, cracked, dented, or otherwise damaged.

causes.label: Expectation mismatch
causes.description: Colour, material, quality, or appearance differs from what the customer expected from the listing.

causes.label: Delivery problem
causes.description: The order arrived late or delivery failed in a way that led to the return.

causes.label: Other
causes.description: No transparent keyword rule matched. Reviewed manually; never used to infer retailer weaknesses.
